task.title: P6-011: Give CommandEmpty a way to distinguish filtering from a failed fetch
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 3 — Leverage: fixes that retire a whole class). Original id: P6-011. Size: M. Specs: specs/ui-components.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**`CommandEmpty` can only ever speak about *filtering*, and three pickers lean on it to describe a failed fetch.** `command.rs:315-330` infers emptiness purely from the item registry, so zero registered items conflates not-fetched / failed / genuinely-empty — the exact collapse the set picker's four arms exist to refuse (`rail.rs:1071-1076` is that workaround). **It cannot be fixed in place**: the ⌘K palette's "No matches" depends on precisely that inference (`palette.rs:957-959`). So either `CommandEmpty` grows a way to distinguish the cases, or every consumer keeps supplying its own error arm above it. Worth resolving at the primitive before a fourth consumer repeats it; `P6-160` is the same conflation showing as a visible bug.
